title: Model/harness ablation: raw planner outputs and chemistry audit

task_prompts.sp: Calculate single-point energy (B3LYP/def2-SVP) for pyruvic acid, furan, and caffeine. Run them in parallel where possible. For each compound report SP energy (energy_eh), HOMO-LUMO gap (homo_lumo_gap_ev), and dipole moment (dipole_moment_debye).
task_prompts.pka: calculate the alpha-CH pKa of ethyl acetylacetate, barbituric acid, acetone, and ethyl chloroacetate. Use ethanal (acetaldehyde, experimental pKa=17.0) as an isodesmic calibration reference to correct the systematic gas-phase DFT error.
task_prompts.eas: rank EAS reactivity of naphthalene, pyrrole, imidazole, pyrazole, thiophene, thiazole using Mulliken charges from DFT

audit_definitions.solvation_or_calibration: DECISIVE. The plan takes one of the two defensible routes to a pKa: compute in solution, or compute in the gas phase with an isodesmic reference that cancels the missing solvation. A bare gas-phase deprotonation with neither is wrong by hundreds of pKa units.
audit_definitions.solvation_in_method: INFORMATIONAL, not scored as a defect. A solvation keyword (CPCM/SMD/COSMO/PCM) appears inside the method string of at least one tool node; ORCA accepts solvation only there. Recorded because it identifies which of the two routes the plan took. Scoring it as a requirement would misgrade the isodesmic route, which the benchmark prompt explicitly requests.
audit_definitions.no_inert_solvation_keys: No solvent/solvation key appears in settings or node args without the method string also carrying solvation. Such a key is inert: the plan reads as solvated and the job runs gas-phase.
audit_definitions.freq_not_sp: Gibbs energies come from run_freq_job, not run_sp_energy.
audit_definitions.deterministic_pka: The pKa arithmetic is done by compute_pka_calibrated rather than by a language-model node.
audit_definitions.proton_ref_sane: A hard-wired thermal proton reference (-0.01372 Eh) is present only when reference acids are supplied, i.e. only where it cancels.
audit_definitions.calibration_refs_used: The isodesmic calibration references requested by the prompt are actually passed to the calculation.
audit_definitions.no_needless_freq: A single-point task does not request frequencies.
audit_definitions.opt_before_charges: Charges are taken from an optimised geometry.

per_compound.prompt: You are given Mulliken charges as a JSON list of {atom_index, symbol, charge} for an aromatic/heteroaromatic molecule. Task: rank electrophilic aromatic substitution (EAS) susceptibility by charge. Filter atoms to include all carbons (symbol == "C") and also heteroatoms (symbol in ["N","O","S"]) if present. Sort ascending by charge (most negative first). Return JSON with ONLY the top-level key "site_ranking", a list of {atom_index, symbol, mulliken_charge, rank} including all filtered atoms. Use 1-based ranks. Do not invent labels/positions; only atom_index.

post_template.prompt: Compare EAS activation across molecules using Mulliken-charge site rankings. For each molecule, take the most activated carbon site as rank=1 among symbol=="C" (if no carbon entries, fall back to overall rank=1). Define an activation score = (most_negative_carbon_charge). Rank molecules by activation score ascending (more negative = more activated). Return JSON with a single top-level key "eas_comparison" containing a list of {molecule, best_site_atom_index, best_site_symbol, best_site_mulliken_charge, molecule_rank}. Use molecule names: naphthalene, pyrrole, imidazole, pyrazole, thiophene, thiazole.
